pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chart-pie against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-chart-pie id="c" label="Заказы по каналам" category="channel" value="orders" value-format="integer"></sf-chart-pie>
<sf-chart-pie id="r" label="Системы" category="os" value="share" hole="ring" max-parts="5" table="hidden"></sf-chart-pie>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by the parts' shares, the largest first
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.summary

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"web": "Сайт", "shop": "Магазин", "partners": "Партнёры", "phone": "Телефон"}; c.items = [{"channel": "web", "orders": 540}, {"channel": "shop", "orders": 310}, {"channel": "partners", "orders": 120}, {"channel": "phone", "orders": 30}]; const r = document.querySelector('#r'); r.items = [{"os": "Windows", "share": 61}, {"os": "macOS", "share": 17}, {"os": "Linux", "share": 9}, {"os": "Android", "share": 6}, {"os": "iOS", "share": 4}, {"os": "ChromeOS", "share": 1.5}, {"os": "FreeBSD", "share": 0.8}, {"os": "Другие", "share": 0.7}, {"os": "Неизвестно", "share": null}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#c figure'); const s = document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(s.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' '); return f && document.getElementById(f.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Заказы по каналам' && s.getAttribute('aria-roledescription') === 'круговая диаграмма' && /^Частей: 4, всего 1 000\. Сайт: 54 ?% \(540\)\./u.test(d) && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-pie-slice').length === 4; })()

checks.title: the arrows walk the parts clockwise and each move is said; Enter chooses the part
checks.covers: keyboard.host (ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, End, Enter, Escape), events.select

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"web": "Сайт", "shop": "Магазин", "partners": "Партнёры", "phone": "Телефон"}; c.items = [{"channel": "web", "orders": 540}, {"channel": "shop", "orders": 310}, {"channel": "partners", "orders": 120}, {"channel": "phone", "orders": 30}]; const r = document.querySelector('#r'); r.items = [{"os": "Windows", "share": 61}, {"os": "macOS", "share": 17}, {"os": "Linux", "share": 9}, {"os": "Android", "share": 6}, {"os": "iOS", "share": 4}, {"os": "ChromeOS", "share": 1.5}, {"os": "FreeBSD", "share": 0.8}, {"os": "Другие", "share": 0.7}, {"os": "Неизвестно", "share": null}]; return true; })()

(() => { window.__chosen = null; document.querySelector('#c').addEventListener('sf-chart-pie-select', (event) => { window.__chosen = event.detail; }); document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]').focus(); return true; })()

checks.title: past max-parts the smallest fold into «Другое»; a ring says the total; the table keeps every row

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"web": "Сайт", "shop": "Магазин", "partners": "Партнёры", "phone": "Телефон"}; c.items = [{"channel": "web", "orders": 540}, {"channel": "shop", "orders": 310}, {"channel": "partners", "orders": 120}, {"channel": "phone", "orders": 30}]; const r = document.querySelector('#r'); r.items = [{"os": "Windows", "share": 61}, {"os": "macOS", "share": 17}, {"os": "Linux", "share": 9}, {"os": "Android", "share": 6}, {"os": "iOS", "share": 4}, {"os": "ChromeOS", "share": 1.5}, {"os": "FreeBSD", "share": 0.8}, {"os": "Другие", "share": 0.7}, {"os": "Неизвестно", "share": null}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('#r .sf-chart-pie-legend-name')].map((one) => one.textContent.trim()); return names.length === 5 && names[4] === 'Другое' && document.querySelector('#r .sf-chart-pie-total').textContent.trim() === '100' && document.querySelectorAll('#r table tbody tr').length === 9; })()

checks.title: a legend button hides its part, the others' shares are of the rest; reset shows every part

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"web": "Сайт", "shop": "Магазин", "partners": "Партнёры", "phone": "Телефон"}; c.items = [{"channel": "web", "orders": 540}, {"channel": "shop", "orders": 310}, {"channel": "partners", "orders": 120}, {"channel": "phone", "orders": 30}]; const r = document.querySelector('#r'); r.items = [{"os": "Windows", "share": 61}, {"os": "macOS", "share": 17}, {"os": "Linux", "share": 9}, {"os": "Android", "share": 6}, {"os": "iOS", "share": 4}, {"os": "ChromeOS", "share": 1.5}, {"os": "FreeBSD", "share": 0.8}, {"os": "Другие", "share": 0.7}, {"os": "Неизвестно", "share": null}]; return true; })()

(() => { window.__toggled = null; const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.addEventListener('sf-chart-pie-toggle', (event) => { window.__toggled = event.detail; }); c.querySelector('.sf-chart-pie-legend-item[data-part=web]').click(); return true; })()

checks.title: the error state offers a retry that sends refresh

steps.script: (() => { const button = document.querySelector('#e sf-empty-state button'); if (button) button.click(); return true; })()
